Shared behaviour change vs the original snapshot (also present in the reference, reference progress.py:494 and untouched add_task): Task.finished now depends on finished_time instead of completed>=total (base progress.py:479). A task created already complete via add_task(completed>=total) (generated progress.py:986-1000 never sets finished_time) or one that never started reports finished=False until update/advance. Progress.finished (progress.py:632) inherits this. The reference behaves identically, so this is not a candidate-specific defect; it is disclosed here.

Reference-only edits not in the candidate (markup.py `from None` / _Tag, pyproject version bump, console pragma, color docstrings, process_renderables demo and `raise`, docs .rst backticks) are not part of the TimeElapsedColumn/Palette feature and were not counted against the patch.
